name: James G. Blaine
bio: The Republican presidential nominee of 1884 appears in the Cow Boy during that spring's race for the nomination, when he and President Arthur were leading. In June 1884 the paper predicted that Blaine and Logan would be elected.

moments.label: Paper predicted Blaine and Logan would win
